notes: 2026 figures (40 places, 707 vœux confirmés) are given for 2026 and the page says data may change for 2027. Tuition: only the general public-sector rate of 178 EUR/year is quoted; for a Moroccan, non-EU student this would normally be the differentiated rate of 2,902 EUR/year for Licence (see maroc.campusfrance.org "Le coût des études, les bourses", quote "2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence"), which is a general institution-wide figure not stated on this programme page. No application channel given (foreign-diploma applicants use Études en France / Campus France). Subject_taken, prior_study_years_min, intakes and documents not stated for this programme's own page. The "Niveau de français requis ... B2" is a Parcoursup fiche (French/EU Bac channel) but states a language condition; treat as B2 for French. "Non titulaire ... d'un baccalauréat français" conditions from the modalités de candidature concern the foreign-candidate route through Campus France.

note.fr: Aucun détail n'est donné pour le candidat titulaire d'un diplôme étranger hors UE : contactez l'IUT de la Martinique et Campus France Maroc pour vérifier les conditions d'admission et le montant exact des frais de scolarité.
note.en: No details are given for holders of a non-EU foreign diploma: contact I.U.T de la Martinique and Campus France Maroc to check admission conditions and the exact tuition fee.
